lineage: Descendant infrastructure audit; preserve both prior research bundles and signal code byte-for-byte.
objective: Separate historical market publication, receiver observability, and tradable account feasibility. Do not calculate ETF or option returns from index prices.

allow: its sealed order and minute-clock artifacts
official exchange and fund-manager product/rule/data documentation

cash_inventory_diagnostic.instrument_reference: 588000.SH domestic equity ETF, secondary-market cash account only
cash_inventory_diagnostic.unit: abstract inventory unit, not portfolio weight, yuan, or an asserted executable share lot
cash_inventory_diagnostic.desired_cash_units: max(desired_signed_units, 0); clipping is a changed-policy feasibility diagnostic, never an equivalent long/short strategy
cash_inventory_diagnostic.settlement: Purchases locked until first observed minute of next trading day; only settled units may be sold. Inventory carries across years.
cash_inventory_diagnostic.event_schedule: Every frozen order timestamp; plus first observed minute of a new trading day only when pending cash target differs from inventory. Latest target supersedes stale targets; no end-of-day forced sale of locked units.
optimistic_assumptions: immediate complete fills of eligible units
no spread, fee, price limit, suspension, capacity or queue restrictions

option_scope: Product existence and required-data mapping only: STAR50 ETF options begin 2023-06-05. No option strategy, strike search, simulated option price or Layer4 implementation.
review: Prepare one annual order-feasibility pack, manually inspect event and figure, seal chained receipt, then open next year. These are repeat audits, not new blind tests. Whole-policy return optimization is out of scope.
hard_gates: first/revised version retention and evidence hashes
